## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete trigger and what a user or operator experiences after this change. Link the issue or acceptance criterion.

## Validation

Record checks actually run, the relevant scenarios and their results. Include browser/Docker or backup verification where the change requires it.

- [ ] Relevant automated checks passed at this commit.
- [ ] The affected workflow was exercised.
- [ ] API, requirements and operations docs reflect changed behavior.

## Data, integration and release impact

Describe schema/rule/mapping changes, role/approval effects and any migration or reconciliation needed. State rollback steps for material changes.

## Risks or review needed

Name unresolved behavior, cross-system dependencies or decisions requiring a data owner/architect/security review. Do not include credentials or private data.
